import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (keep first occurrence)
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Fix species label variants (lowercase to title case)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.capitalize()
    
    # Fix negative flipper_length_mm (assume typo, make positive)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to number (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and compute average body_mass_g
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().round(2).to_dict()
    return result
